mapper.sql: id, org_id, workspace_id, scope_kind, scope_id, offeror_user_id, offeree_user_id, membership_id, state, created_at, expires_at, closed_at, closed_by_user_id, closure_reason, delivery_state, delivery_workspace_id, delivery_membership_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ownership_offer (org_id, workspace_id, scope_kind, offeror_user_id, offeree_user_id, membership_id, delivery_workspace_id, delivery_membership_id, delivery_state, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{workspaceId}, #{scopeKind}, #{offerorUserId}, #{offereeUserId}, #{membershipId}, #{deliveryWorkspaceId}, #{deliveryMembershipId}, #{deliveryState}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 7 DAY))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ownership_offer WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ownership_offer WHERE id = #{id} FOR SHARE
SELECT FROM ownership_offer WHERE offeree_user_id = #{userId} AND state = 'OPEN' AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY id

SELECT FROM ownership_offer WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND state = 'OPEN'
AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND workspace_id IS NULL
ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM ownership_offer WHERE offeror_user_id = #{userId} OR offeree_user_id = #{userId} OR closed_by_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM ownership_offer WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND state = 'OPEN' ORDER BY id

SELECT FROM ownership_offer WHERE state = 'OPEN' AND (expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organization o WHERE o.id = ownership_offer.org_id AND o.lifecycle_state <> 'active') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace w WHERE w.id = ownership_offer.workspace_id AND w.lifecycle_state <> 'active')) ORDER BY expires_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM ownership_offer WHERE state = 'OPEN' AND delivery_state = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ownership_offer SET state = 'ACCEPTED', closed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), closed_by_user_id = #{offereeUserId}, closure_reason = 'accepted' WHERE id = #{id} AND offeree_user_id = #{offereeUserId} AND state = 'OPEN' AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM ownership_offer WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT w.id FROM workspace w JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = w.id WHERE w.org_id = #{orgId} AND w.lifecycle_state = 'active' AND wm.user_id = #{offereeUserId} AND wm.status = 'active' ORDER BY w.id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ownership_offer SET delivery_state = 'DELIVERED', delivery_workspace_id = #{workspaceId}, delivery_membership_id = #{membershipId} WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'OPEN' AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND delivery_state = 'PENDING'
UPDATE ownership_offer SET closed_by_user_id = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND closed_by_user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ownership_offer WHERE id = #{id} AND state <> 'OPEN' AND (offeror_user_id = #{userId} OR offeree_user_id = #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM org_member WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND user_id = #{userId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_member wm JOIN workspace w ON w.id = wm.workspace_id WHERE w.org_id = #{orgId} AND w.lifecycle_state = 'active' AND wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'active' AND wm.workspace_id <> #{excludedWorkspaceId})
SELECT FROM ownership_offer WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} OR delivery_workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE ownership_offer SET delivery_workspace_id = NULL, delivery_membership_id = NULL, delivery_state = 'NONE' WHERE id = #{id} AND delivery_workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ownership_offer WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} OR delivery_workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace WHERE id = #{workspaceId})
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_recipient_state SET state_version = state_version + 1 WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId}
